name: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk
summary: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution and retail of mobile telecommunication devices in Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, and internationally. It operates through Cellular Phones and Tablets, Operator Products, Computer & Other Electronic Devices, and Accessories and Others segments. The company offers consumer electronics, handsets, laptops, computers, operator business and vouchers under the Erafone store, iBox, Samsung, Mi-store, and other brands; and lifestyle-related products, such as accessories, Internet of Things, sport fashion apparel, and other outdoor activity-related products under the Urban Republic & JD Sports, ASICS, DJI, Garmin, …
